title: Start with an empty scene
summary: Build only what the scene needs while keeping the viewport in focus.

steps.title: Add scene content
steps.description: Use the Add menu or scripting API to create geometry, lights, cameras, or other scene elements.

steps.title: Choose a working context
steps.description: Select a context from the left rail when you need focused authoring controls.

steps.title: Open an editor when needed
steps.description: Use the bottom editor switcher for graphs, animation, materials, assets, or diagnostics.
